test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of this sentence:

(A) their demands

(B) the workers

(C) went on strike

(D) after the management rejected
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **BCDA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "The workers," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following the subject, "went on strike" **(BC)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what the workers did.
 
• **The next part,** "after the management rejected" **(BCD)** explains the reason for the strike.
 
• **Ending with **"their demands" (BCDA) completes the sentence by stating what was rejected by the management.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCDA.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DBAC):** This option starts with "after the management rejected the workers went on strike," which makes the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 2 (DACB):** This option starts with "after the management rejected their demands the workers," which disrupts the logical subject-verb-object flow.
 
• **Option 4 (BACD):** This option starts with "the workers their demands went on strike after the management rejected," which is confusing and grammatically incorrect.
